method_statement_steps.template_title: Method Statement for RCC Beam Work
method_statement_steps.purpose: To define the sequence and control requirements for RCC beam construction.
method_statement_steps.scope: Applicable to RCC beam formwork, reinforcement placement, concreting, compaction, and curing.
method_statement_steps.safety_notes: Use PPE, provide safe access, ensure stable formwork, and restrict unauthorized access during concreting.
method_statement_steps.quality_notes: Check line, level, dimensions, reinforcement, cover, concrete quality, compaction, and curing.
method_statement_steps.step_description: Verify beam location, span, breadth, depth, levels, and supporting points using approved drawings and shared project element data.
method_statement_steps.inspection_point: Confirm beam dimensions and coordinates before work starts.

specification_clauses.general_requirement: RCC beam work shall be executed according to approved drawings, project specifications, and accepted engineering practice.
specification_clauses.clause_text: Concrete shall be cured after initial setting and protected from premature drying, impact, or disturbance.
specification_clauses.acceptance_criteria: Curing shall be maintained for the required project duration.

specification_clauses.general_requirement: RCC beam work shall be executed according to approved drawings, project specifications, and accepted engineering practice.
specification_clauses.clause_text: Concrete shall be placed without segregation and compacted properly using appropriate vibration.
specification_clauses.acceptance_criteria: Concrete shall be compact, uniform, and free from honeycombing.

specification_clauses.general_requirement: RCC beam work shall be executed according to approved drawings, project specifications, and accepted engineering practice.
specification_clauses.clause_text: Reinforcement shall be placed as per approved structural drawings with required cover, spacing, laps, hooks, and anchorage.
specification_clauses.acceptance_criteria: Bar diameter, spacing, cover, and placement shall match approved drawings.

specification_clauses.general_requirement: RCC beam work shall be executed according to approved drawings, project specifications, and accepted engineering practice.
specification_clauses.clause_text: Formwork shall be rigid, properly supported, leak-proof, and set to correct line, level, and dimensions.
specification_clauses.acceptance_criteria: No excessive deflection, leakage, or dimensional deviation.

specification_clauses.general_requirement: RCC beam work shall be executed according to approved drawings, project specifications, and accepted engineering practice.
specification_clauses.clause_text: Concrete, reinforcement, binding wire, cover blocks, and formwork materials shall conform to approved project requirements.
specification_clauses.acceptance_criteria: Materials shall be approved before use.
